text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's hurry and go! There's a 
huge feast, cake, presents, and so much 
more!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second! Calm down a bit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem* First off, thank you. I'm so happy 
you celebrated for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still... where are we supposed to go? What 
about the feast and the cake and all...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!! I think I forgot to tell them 
about the birthday party!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A birthday party...? I-I haven't heard 
anything about this?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sowwy!! But listen, listen! We all 
prepared it together! I worked super hard 
on it too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know what? I made a bunch of flowers 
and decorated my room with them! And an 
origami chain, too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It was tough to make it properly, but 
everyone praised it! I really want 
King-chan to see it too~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
All right. I suppose this is part of the 
surprise too. I'm looking forward to the 
birthday party. Will you show me the way?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! Look forward to it! I'm gonna sing 
Happy Birthday at the top of my lungs for 
you!
